'''Chapter 166''' is titled "Luffy vs. Vivi".

==Cover Page==
[[Jango's Dance Paradise]], Vol. 31: "Fullbody's Manly, Tearful Objection DANCE!!".

In the nick of time, [[Fullbody]]—and his entire squad—intercede [[Jango]]'s trial with a heartfelt objection.

==Short Summary==
[[Crocodile]] discovers that the Straw Hat Pirates are still alive, but thanks to [[Bentham|Mr. 2]], he is able to take countermeasures so that [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] and the rebels would not be able to meet each other. Meanwhile Vivi and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] start to dispute each other.

==Long Summary==
An old face interrupts [[Baroque Works]] meeting. It is no other than [[Galdino|Mr. 3]], who snuck in after the other members from Spiders Cafe. He came to be given another chance to defeat the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]]. Crocodile is surprised by this revelation since, after the call from [[Little Garden]], he assumed all of the Straw Hat Pirates and Vivi were dead as he was not aware that it was [[Sanji]] who answered the call and lied to him. [[Bentham|Mr. 2]] confirms that the Straw Hat Pirates and Vivi are alive since he met them on the way to [[Arabasta]]. With the help of his power, they are able to make pictures of the Straw Hats (omitting Sanji), and start to take counter measures so that they can prevent Vivi from meeting with the rebel leader, [[Koza]]. Disappointed with [[Galdino|Mr. 3]], instead of giving him a second chance, Crocodile dries him up and feeds him to his [[Animal Species/Arabasta Saga#Bananawani|Bananawani]].

Meanwhile, Luffy and Vivi's argument is intensifying. Luffy finds her naïve in wishing for no one to die. Upset, Vivi and Luffy start a fight until Luffy reveals his true intention: he wants Vivi to risk the life of her friends with her so that he can beat [[Crocodile]], who is responsible for this situation.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Bentham|Mr. 2]] is able to confirm the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]]' presence in [[Arabasta]] and uses his power to show their faces (excluding [[Sanji]]).
*Aside from Sanji, [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] is not put on [[Baroque Works]]' hit list due to being mistaken as the Straw Hats' pet.
*[[Crocodile]] sends [[Galdino|Mr. 3]] to death under the wrath of a [[Animal Species/Arabasta Saga#Bananawani|Bananawani]].
*Luffy makes it clear that instead of wasting their time going after the rebels they should go after Crocodile instead.
